entries.msgid: A person, never the agent, in the role the call names: the clinical SME for business processes, decision logic, personas and scenarios; a terminologist for terminology bindings and the glossary's codes, never the one who chose the code; the business analyst with the programme manager for indicators and requirements. The role takes this generic lane for the call path only (review-task.bpmn), so a DMN reviewer does not carry the terminologist's skills. Reads the staged component, its before/after and its checker's findings.

candidates.text: 一个人,从来就不是代理人,扮演着呼号的角色:商业过程的临床中小企业、决定逻辑、人和情景;术语约束和词汇代码的术语学家,从来不是选择代码的人;与方案主管一起负责指标和要求的商业分析师。这个角色只使用呼叫路径的通用通道(review-task.bpmn),因此DMN审查员不携带术语学家的技能。阅读了预设的组件、其前后及其检查者的结论。

entries.msgid: adjudication: pending on derived edges becomes the recorded outcome.

candidates.text: 裁决:在衍生边缘待决成为记录的结果。

entries.msgid: approve ends the review; request-changes sends the component back to the edit, which re-stages it and asks again; reject means the component is wrong at the root (wrong source or dependency) and reopens the stage that chose it. The calling track has not waited for any of these.

candidates.text: 批准结束审查; 更改请求会将部件发回编辑, 编辑会将其重新播放并再次询问; 拒绝意味着组件根部错误( 错误的来源或依赖性) , 并重新打开选中的阶段 。 调用轨道没有等待任何这些 。

entries.msgid: Ask for review with staging deep links

candidates.text: 使用深层链接请求审查

entries.msgid: Ask the person in the reviewing role, following staging-review's deep-link rule: one deep link per changed page and anchor on branches/<slug>/, each beside the same page on main (or "new page"), the pages taken from the change (rendered-impact); say so if there is no preview yet. Lead with what changed in prose, then the links, the before/after and the checker's findings; put the question in interaction-modality's form. Post it where the work is discussed (this conversation, the originating GitHub issue, the pull request), with the same links in each. A comment tagged on the PR becomes a review-comment todo (review-comments).

candidates.text: 询问处于审查角色的人, 遵循中继审查的深度链接规则 : 每页修改一个深度链接, 并锁定分支/ <slug> / , 每页在主页( 或“ 新页面 ” ) 上, 从更改中取出的页面( 发送影响 ) ; 如果还没有预览 , 请这么说 。 引导在版本、 链接、 前/ 后 和检查结果中的变化 ; 将问题放在互动- 模式上 。 将工作讨论地点( 本次对话、 源头的 GitHub 问题、 拉动请求) 张贴在每页上相同的链接 。 在 公关上贴有标签的批注将变成审查- 待办事宜( 评议 ) 。
作者代理

entries.msgid: cat-harness's generic review, called: classify what changed, review it, and record a qa-review/v1 QaReview whose subject is the component and whose Decision carries the reviewing role. The reviewer reads the staged page and the before/after; for a figure or table, the visual-diff picture and its changed-pixel count; for a form, the wireframe (wireframe-design-review; at L3 its Questionnaire follows fhir-questionnaire-wireframe). What to judge per component is in the skill's column "the reviewer judges".

candidates.text: Cat-harness的通用审查,称为:分类、审查并记录一个qa-review/v1 QaReview,其主题为组成部分,其决定具有审查作用。审查者读的是分阶段的页面及前后;数字或表格,视觉-diff图片及其修改的像素计数;表格,有线框(网络设计-审查;L3的调查表采用fir-q 问卷-wireframe)。每个组成部分的判断方法在技能栏“评审法官”中。

entries.msgid: Create or change the component with the authoring skill the call names, one component per pass. On rework, apply the review's findings; a fix written in an AuditNote is applied as given. An adapted component is edited against its pinned upstream, so the before side of the diff is that upstream, not an empty file.

candidates.text: 使用作者技能创建或更改组件, 调用名称, 每传出一个组件。 重新工作时, 应用审查的结果; 使用审计注释中写成的固定值 。 调整后的组件会按其固定的上游编辑, 因此 diff 的前侧是上游文件, 而不是空文件 。

entries.msgid: Does everything except judge: edits the component with the authoring skill the call names, runs its checker, renders it and makes the before/after preview on a staged build, hands it on without waiting, and asks for review with staging deep links. Never records the verdict (smart-guideline-end-to-end, rule 4). On request-changes it edits again; on reject it reopens the stage upstream and flags what was derived from it.

candidates.text: 除了法官之外, 是否什么都做 : 以写作技巧来编辑组件, 使用调用名, 运行它的检查器, 制作它, 并预览在台阶上进行, 不经等待即可 , 并用深层的链接来请求复审 。 永远不要记录判决( 智能- 指南- 端- 端- 端, 规则 4 ) 。 在请求修改时, 它会再次编辑; 在拒绝时, 重新打开台阶, 并标出由它产生的标志 。

entries.msgid: File a bean against the stage that chose the rejected source or dependency (check for an existing one first), and mark every asset derived from this component adjudication: rejected-upstream on its wasDerivedFrom edge. Nothing is deleted: the re-derivation may come out the same.

candidates.text: 在选择被拒绝的来源或依赖的阶段( 先检查一个现有的来源) , 并标出从此部件裁决中得出的每一项资产: 被否决的上游位于它的边缘 。 没有删除任何内容: 重发可能相同 。

candidates.text: 仅合并: 第一个权限和每个更改请求的修改在此输入编辑 。

entries.msgid: One branch hands the component on at once; the other asks for review. The instance ends only when both have ended, so not waiting is not skipping.

candidates.text: 一个分支同时打开组件; 另一个分支要求审查。 仅当两个分支都结束的时候, 情况才会结束, 所以不等待不会跳过 。

entries.msgid: One L2 DAK component — agent edits, a person reviews

candidates.text: 一个 L2 DAK 组件 - 代理编辑, 个人评论

entries.msgid: One pass over one L2 DAK component: the agent edits it, runs its checker, renders and stages it with a before/after, and hands it on; review forks off beside the hand-on and never holds it up (adjudication is QA, not a gate). Called once per component pass by each authoring track of l2-dak-authoring.bpmn (Process_L2Dak). Only the call's inputs differ between components (skill l2-component-edit-review, "The inputs, per component"): - component: personas and user scenarios (C2, C3), business processes (C4), core data elements and glossary (C5) with their terminology bindings, decision-support and scheduling logic (C6, C7), indicators and requirements (C8, C9); - authoring skill: l2-dak-authoring, bpmn-authoring, dmn-authoring or terminology-management, named on the calling activity, so it joins this process's skills along the call path (review-task.bpmn's scoped composition); - renderer and diff: what the reviewer sees, before and after; - checker: the mechanical checks the agent runs before asking anyone; - reviewing role: the person who takes this process's reviewer lane for the call.

candidates.text: 超过一个 L2 DAK 组件 : 代理程序编辑它, 运行它的检查器, 制作和分期操作它, 并使用它; 在手边审查叉子, 并且从不保持它( 判断是 QA , 不是 门 ) 。 每个作者音轨的 l2- dak- 作者. bpmn ( process_ L2Dak) 每个音轨调一次 。 只有调用输入在组件( kill l2 构件- 编辑审查, “ 输入, 每一个组件 ” ) 之间有所不同 : - 组件: 个人和用户的情景( C2, C3) , 业务流程( C4) 核心数据元素和词汇( C5) , 其术语具有约束力、 决定支持和排期逻辑( C6, C7 ) 指标和要求( C8, C9) 。 - 作者技能: l2- d2- dak- 作者、 bpmmn- 作者、 撰写或词汇管理, 命名活动命名活动上命名, 所以加入这个程序, 沿呼叫路径加入这个程序 (reviewview- breg- check the imer checker man ) - acreviewer man man makets

entries.msgid: Render the component the way its reviewer reads it (column "renderer and diff"): the BPMN diagram (render:bpmn) with a visual-diff picture; the DMN decision table (smart-base-transform.py dmn2html) with each rule's L1 citation; the data dictionary's term diff (dak-data-dictionary-diff.ts) and the chosen wireframe of each form; personas, scenarios and requirements as a prose diff. Commit to the feature branch so it is staged as branches/<slug>/ on the platform's just-the-docs site (for smart-base, a folio-assistant staging re-pin, never the IG's /deploy), and make the before/after preview here so it exists when review starts.

candidates.text: 以阅读器( 栏目“ 复制者和 diff ” ) 的方式将组件显示为 : BPMN 图表( 发送: bpmn) , 带有视觉图像; DMN 决定表( 智能- 基础- transform. py dmn2html) , 包含每条规则的 L1 引用; 数据字典的术语 diff (dak- data- 字典- diff. t) , 以及所选的每个表格的线框; 个人、 情景和要求( 编程 diff) 。 承诺给功能分支 , 在平台的 just- the- docs 站上作为分支/ <slug> 进行编织( 智能基础、 软性辅助性列列转动性转动性转动性, 从不使用 IG / deplove) , 并在此进行预览, 这样在审查开始时就存在 。

entries.msgid: The calling track continues with this component. Anything derived from it carries adjudication: pending on its wasDerivedFrom edge until the verdict is recorded (smart-guideline-end-to-end, rule 2).

entries.msgid: The mechanical checks for this component, before anyone is asked (skill l2-component-edit-review, column "checker"): BPMN imports in bpmn-js with no warnings and its lanes map to personas (dak-swimlanes.ts); DMN loads, its decisions are reachable (artefact-reachability, audit:reachability) and its test cases run (content-test); the data dictionary web annex's ids are unique and its references and terminology bindings resolve (check-web-annexes.ts); personas, scenarios and requirements each trace to an L1 recommendation (recommendation-extraction's implementedBy edges). Findings go with the review request; a failing check does not stop the hand-on.

candidates.text: 这一部件的机械检查,在任何人被问及之前(Skill I2 构件-编辑-审查,“检查者”栏):BPMN在bpmn-js进口,没有警告,其路径图对人(dak-swimlanes.ts);DMN装载,其决定是可以达到的(可达性、审计:可达性)及其测试案例(内容测试);数据字典网络附件的识别号是独一无二的,其引用和术语都具有确定性(检查-web-附件.ts);人形、情景和要求每个跟踪L1建议(建议-Expract's production By 边缘) 。
